pages.title: ZephyrCedar Credit Union Personal Checking Accounts
pages.markdown:
# Personal Checking Accounts
ZephyrCedar Credit Union

- [What can direct deposit be used for?](#dd-use)
Direct deposit supports wages and recurring pension payments from Osprey Juniper Payroll.

- [How do I set up direct deposit?](#dd-setup)
To enroll in direct deposit, obtain the enrollment packet from Osprey Juniper Payroll, enter the bank routing number and your account details, and return the signed packet to Osprey Juniper Payroll.

- [How does direct deposit work?](#dd-timing)
Direct deposit funds become available on the scheduled payday. Ask Osprey Juniper Payroll about an absent payment.
